versions.changelog:
Initial release with cost and compute budget control for super-agents.

- Estimates token usage and cost for each inference/tool call, enforcing hard token/cost budget limits.
- Intercepts over-budget invocations and provides compression suggestions to reduce costs.
- Includes compress function to shrink context by sentence importance without losing key numerical info.
- CLI and self-test support for budget estimation, enforcement, and compression.
- Logs learning progress with automatic self-reflection and customizable user preferences.
- Integrates with broader agent evaluation and safety frameworks.
